name: Shecaniah
overview: Shecaniah is a male biblical figure identified uniquely as the son of Jehiel, as recorded in Ezra 10:2. There is no specific tribal affiliation or additional notes provided about him in Scripture. His mention is brief but distinct in the context of the post-exilic community.
namesAndTitles: The name Shecaniah means "YHWH has taken up his abode," reflecting a theologically rich meaning that emphasizes God's presence. This proper name, given apart from direct divine naming, appears in Ezra 10:2 and highlights a spiritual dimension to his identity.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture explicitly records Shecaniah as the son of Jehiel according to Ezra 10:2. Beyond this paternal relationship, no other family connections are documented in the biblical text.
scriptureSignificance: Shecaniah's significance lies in his identification as a son of Jehiel during the critical period of Israel's return from exile. His mention in Ezra 10:2 situates him within the community addressing covenant faithfulness and reform, underscoring the role of families in restoring holiness. Though not extensively detailed, Shecaniah represents the faithful remnant committed to God's covenant.
